description: This file defines the LogFragment class, a subclass of Fragment, which manages a LogView within a ScrollView to display log messages in an Android application. It includes methods to create and initialize the view hierarchy, handle text change events, and provide access to the LogView component.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that hosts a LogView widget within a ScrollView, responsible for displaying log messages and auto-scrolling to the bottom when new logs are added.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the view hierarchy containing a ScrollView and a LogView, setting layout parameters, styles, padding, and other properties.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, attaches a TextWatcher to the LogView to handle auto-scrolling when text changes, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
